definitions.gloss: handy; simple; convenient; easy to use
definitions.explanation: Simple and convenient, requiring little effort or complexity. Used to describe methods, tools, or procedures that are straightforward and practical.

examples.japanese: {簡便|かんべん}な⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{調|しら}べた→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: I checked using a simple method.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{簡便|かんべん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{使|つか}いやすい→使いやすい：30380_tsukaiyasui⟧。
examples.english: This tool is handy and easy to use.

examples.japanese: {簡便|かんべん}な⟦{操作|そうさ}→操作：03316_sousa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{使|つか}える→使う：00473_tsukau⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{設計|せっけい}→設計：03300_sekkei⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It's designed so that anyone can use it with simple operation.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word combining {簡|かん} (simple) and ⟦{便|べん}→便：26147_ben⟧ (convenient). Common in technical writing, product descriptions, and formal documents. Less casual than ⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {簡便|かんべん}な⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧ (a simple method)
- {簡便|かんべん}な⟦{操作|そうさ}→操作：03316_sousa⟧ (simple operation)
- {簡便|かんべん}さ (simplicity, handiness)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧: simple, easy — more common and casual
- ⟦{手軽|てがる}→手軽：07176_tegaru⟧: easy, casual — emphasizes lack of effort or formality
- ⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧: convenient — focuses on usefulness
